device_name: Shoreline RT Reef Topography ACDF Spacer Titanium Coated PEEK

specs.Configuration: Cage Alone , Low profile plate attached

description: The Shoreline RT is an Anterior cervical spacer for use in the ACDF procedure. It features Reef Topography that has undercut edges and allows for increased mechanical stability in conjunction with the NanoMetalene titanium coated PEEK. It is compatible with the TruProfile minimal-profile Anterior cervical plate.
features: Reef Topography with undercut grooves allows for graft impaction and increased grip on bone
Compatible with TruProfile Anterior Cervical plate
